headline: Approved waivers of competition and awarded multiple bids for fire, library, and public works projects
summary: The Finance Committee approved minutes from August 10, 2026, and voted on several purchases and contract awards. These included fire station alerting hardware, traffic line marking, lead abatement, an all-terrain litter picker, a dump trailer, a pickup truck, a paving project, and HVAC work for the library. All motions passed 3-0.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the previous meeting dated August 10, 2026, vote 3-0
Authorized a Waiver of Competition for fire station alerting hardware from Westnet, LLC, at $36,822.71, vote 3-0
Approved the second and final one-year extension for bid 2023-066 Traffic Line Marking with K5 Corp. through June 30, 2027, at $175,309.20, vote 3-0
Awarded bid 2026-047 for lead abatement of 79 Howard St. to RC Group, Biddeford, ME, at $44,660, vote 3-0
Authorized a Waiver of Competition with C.N. Wood Co. for an all-terrain litter picker at $99,083, vote 3-0
Awarded bid 2026-043 for a dump trailer with brush and log loader to Pete's Equipment, Morrisville, VT, at $87,920, vote 3-0
Awarded bid 2026-044 for a ½ ton crew cab pickup truck to O'Connor Auto Park, Augusta, ME, at $49,712, vote 3-0
Awarded bid 2026-028 for the 2026 Mill and Fill Paving project to Gendron & Gendron, Lewiston, ME, at an estimated $687,120, vote 3-0
Authorized a Waiver of Competition with Salas O'Brien for the Library's HVAC Corrective Action Plan at $113,800, vote 3-0
